text_en: For everything there is a season, and a time for every matter under heaven:
text_cn: 事事有时节，天下任何事皆有定时：

text_en: a time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up what is planted;
text_cn: 生有时，死有时，栽种有时，拔除栽种的亦有时；

text_en: a time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;
text_cn: 杀戮有时，治疗有时，拆毁有时，建筑有时；

text_en: a time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;
text_cn: 哭有时，笑有时，哀悼有时，舞蹈有时；

text_en: a time to throw away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;
text_cn: 抛石有时，堆石有时；拥抱有时，戒避拥抱亦有时；

text_en: a time to seek, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to throw away;
text_cn: 寻找有时，遗失有时；保存有时，舍弃有时；

text_en: a time to tear, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;
text_cn: 撕裂有时，缝缀有时；缄默有时，言谈有时，

text_en: a time to love, and a time to hate; a time for war, and a time for peace.
text_cn: 爱慕有时，憎恨有时；作战有时，和睦有时。

text_en: What gain have the workers from their toil?
text_cn: 工作的人，从劳苦中得了什么利益？

text_en: I have seen the business that God has given to everyone to be busy with.
text_cn: 我观察了天主交予人类所应从事的事务，得知：

text_en: He has made everything suitable for its time; moreover he has put a sense of past and future into their minds, yet they cannot find out what God has done from the beginning to the end.
text_cn: 天主所行的一切事宜，都很适时，并赐给人认识时事的经历，但人仍不能明了，天主自始至终所做的工作。

text_en: I know that there is nothing better for them than to be happy and enjoy themselves as long as they live;
text_cn: 于是我明了：人类的幸福，只有在此生欢乐享受；

text_en: moreover, it is God’s gift that all should eat and drink and take pleasure in all their toil.
text_cn: 但人人有吃有喝，享受自己一切劳苦之所得，也是天主的恩赐。

text_en: I know that whatever God does endures forever; nothing can be added to it, nor anything taken from it; God has done this, so that all should stand in awe before him.
text_cn: 我知道：凡天主所行的事，永恒不变，无一可增，无一可减。天主这样作，是为叫人敬畏他。

text_en: That which is, already has been; that which is to be, already is; and God seeks out what has gone by.
text_cn: 现今所有的，早已有过；将来所有的，先前已有过；因为天主必追寻已往的事。

text_en: Moreover I saw under the sun that in the place of justice, wickedness was there, and in the place of righteousness, wickedness was there as well.
text_cn: 我在太阳下还看见：正义之处有不义，公平之处有不平。

text_en: I said in my heart, God will judge the righteous and the wicked, for he has appointed a time for every matter, and for every work.
text_cn: 我心里想天主必要审判义人和恶人，因为各种事情和行为，在天主那里都有其定时。

text_en: I said in my heart with regard to human beings that God is testing them to show that they are but animals.
text_cn: 我想，天主藉此是为使世人认清自己是谁，看清自己与走兽无异。

text_en: For the fate of humans and the fate of animals is the same; as one dies, so dies the other. They all have the same breath, and humans have no advantage over the animals; for all is vanity.
text_cn: 的确，世人的命运，同走兽的命运，都是一样：前者怎样死，后者也怎样死；气息都一样，人并不优于走兽：因为都是虚无。

text_en: All go to one place; all are from the dust, and all turn to dust again.
text_cn: 都同归于一处；既都出于尘土，也都归于尘土。

text_en: Who knows whether the human spirit goes upward and the spirit of animals goes downward to the earth?
text_cn: 人的气息是否向上高升，走兽的气息是否下降地下，有谁知道？

text_en: So I saw that there is nothing better than that all should enjoy their work, for that is their lot; who can bring them to see what will be after them?
text_cn: 因此，我看出：人最好还是享受自己劳苦之所得，因为这是他的命运；有谁能领他去看自己身后的事呢？
